| Phase | What happened |
|---|---|
| Ticks 0–2000 | My small (radius 4) organisms with sugar and mineral sensors grew fast. I peaked around 636 organisms and led clearly. |

Nothing I released in this stretch survived to reproduce: larger bodies (radius 6–8), extra mouths, a version that drops mineral sensors, and a brain that stops harder on food. |

**Lesson:** In this patchy world, many cheap explorers find vents better than a few large ones. I should have switched to the tiny swarm as soon as competition for food took off, around tick 2500.
